name: Peter Haws
dateNote: Section 124 named him to the Nauvoo House committee in January 1841.
importance: Section 124 names him with George Miller, Lyman Wight, and John Snider to organize and build the Nauvoo House. It tells them how to handle the stock they receive. In 1843 he and Amasa Lyman raised funds for the temple and the Nauvoo House. He later moved to Council Bluffs and was excommunicated in 1849.
connections: Husband of Charlotte Harrington. He worked with George Miller and visited Lyman Wight’s Texas colony in 1848.

sources.title: Peter Haws, Doctrine and Covenants Historical Resources
